widget.instructions: Step through the explanation, then press Play to see what the forces do to the sliding box.

steps.text: A box slides to the right after a push has ended. Before drawing any arrow, ask: what is pushing or pulling, and is it touching the box?
Gravity acts without touching: the Earth pulls the box down with its weight.
The floor touches the box: it pushes up (the normal force) and rubs against the sliding box (friction, backwards).
Nothing else touches the box, so there is no 'force of motion'. It keeps moving by inertia while friction slows it. Press Play.

accessibility.altText: A box sliding right on a floor. Forces are added one at a time: weight, normal force and friction.
accessibility.nonDragAlternative: Step through with Next; the description below the board lists each force and its agent.
